choices.family: The 5 contrasts are registration B section 5, H4 synthetic family, items 1 to 5, in that order, with Holm over the 5 p values. Each is a paired difference per base object and model.
choices.panel: The panel is the 7 models that ran Track I (PANEL). gemini-3.8-flash has no Track I answer at the filing; if it runs later, its answers do not enter these tests (registration B section 5b).
choices.reply: The reply is the last top-level JSON object in the answer text: the scan starts at each `{` from the left, and an object that parses moves the scan to its end. No object is a parse failure.
choices.V0: V0 is the closed JSON schema of the request's family and variant in main/track_i/schema_snapshot.json (keys, types, enums, no extra key). A boolean is never a string, and a string is never a boolean.
choices.V1: V1 is the typed validator of PLAN SI-05 for the Track I report, on a reply that passes V0. It rejects: an organization name that is not one of the 6 names of the object (after whitespace and case folding); an organization twice in `ranking`, twice in `unacceptable`, or in both; two conditions with the same organization and attribute; a report with all three lists empty; and a label without a canonical value in the variant's attribute table. Reason: PLAN SI-05 lists unknown values, duplicate or overlapping organizations and an all-empty report; the SI-05 validator itself does not exist yet.
choices.canonical: A V1-valid reply is mapped to the canonical labels by the attribute table of its variant (schema_snapshot.json, `attributes`: name to canonical name, label to canonical value), and it is compared with `gold_canonical` of main/track_i/gold.jsonl.
choices.fields: The fields are those of the repository rule (semantic-integrity si_eval/extraction_task.py, _erroneous_fields), without valuations: `acceptability:<org>` for each of the 6 organizations (acceptable = in `ranking`, unacceptable = in `unacceptable`, else unspecified); `conditions:<org>.<attribute>` for each pair in the gold or the reply; `ranking:full` when the ranked set differs or two organizations of both rankings change order.
choices.silent error: A read scores 1 when it passes V0 and V1 and at least one field differs from the gold, and 0 when it passes V0 and V1 and no field differs. Reason: PLAN SI-08, a field value that passes V1 and differs from the constructive gold; one read is the unit of a cell.
choices.missing: A read is a missing cell for the silent error when it has no row, its row did not succeed, it did not stop at end_turn, or it fails the parse, V0 or V1. Reason: registration A section 7 (a V0 failure or a cut reply is a missing cell); a V1 failure is loud, so it is not silent.
choices.gold check: Before any answer is scored, the gold of each of the 1,200 requests, in the labels of its variant, must pass V0 and V1 and score 0. Else the script stops.
choices.contrast value: Per base object and model, a contrast is the sum of its terms, coefficient times the value. A term on one wording is the read of that cell. A term on the two rewordings is the mean of their valid reads (one or two). A contrast with a term without a value has no value.
choices.panel mean: Per base object, the mean of the contrast over the panel models that have a value. A base object without any value leaves the test. Each base object has equal weight.
choices.test: Two-sided sign-flip permutation test of the mean over base objects (stats.permutation_test), 10,000 draws, seed PERMUTATION_SEED, the same seed for each contrast. Holm (stats.holm) over the 5 contrasts. A contrast rejects when its Holm p is 0.05 or less.
choices.predicted signs: Contrast 1 (renaming) negative, 2 (descriptions) negative, 3 (wording) positive, 4 (interaction) positive, 5 (value label) negative. The tests are two-sided. The signs are used by the claim rules (contrasts 1, 3 and 5) and to break a zero mean in the worst case.
choices.claims: Claim 1 holds on constructed items when contrasts 3 and 1 reject with the predicted signs. The anchoring reading holds when Claim 1 holds and contrast 5 rejects with the predicted sign. Reason: registration B section 5, Claim 1 (decision D1).
choices.worst case: Each missing cell is scored in the direction that shrinks the contrast: against the sign of the primary panel mean of that contrast (the predicted sign when the mean is 0). A cell whose term has a coefficient of the same sign scores 0, else 1. Then the same test and Holm run again.
choices.intervals: Every interval is the 95% percentile interval of stats.cluster_bootstrap, 2,000 draws, BOOTSTRAP_SEED. The cluster is the base object.
choices.per model: Each model's paired effect is the mean of its contrast values over the base objects, with its interval. The exact sign test of each model is a description, not a registered test.
choices.per word: Part 4 gives each contrast on the 25 base objects of each collision word, with its interval and no test. Reason: PLAN SI-11, the results per collision word as description.
choices.all errors: Secondary, no test: a read scores 1 when it fails the parse, V0 or V1, or has a silent error, and 0 when it passes V1 with no wrong field. A read with no row, a row that did not succeed or a cut reply is missing. Reason: PLAN SI-08, all errors add the V0 and V1 failures.
choices.unsupported commitment: Secondary, no test: a V1-valid read scores 1 when it states a condition (organization and attribute) that the gold does not state, else 0. Reason: PLAN SI-08, a value for a field that the text leaves not stated; every Track I text states one condition.
choices.one read: Track I has one read per cell (PLAN SI-10). There is no repeat analysis.
choices.frozen inputs: Every file of main/track_i/SHA256SUMS must have its hash, the SHA-256 of SHA256SUMS must equal track_i_sha256sums of main/wave2_track_i_manifest.json, and the manifest must give 1,200 requests for each panel model.
choices.input check: The input folder must hold em2i_<model> folders of the panel only, and unseal_manifest.json with the same panel. Each raw.jsonl must match the SHA-256 and row count of the manifest. `._*` files are ignored.

tests.text: collision wording minus the mean of the two rewordings, under a_legacy
wording effect under a_legacy minus wording effect under b_renamed

part2_missing.rule: A read with no row, a row that did not succeed, a cut reply, or a parse, V0 or V1 failure is a missing cell for the silent error. The primary test leaves it out. The worst case scores it in the direction that shrinks the contrast.

worst_case.text: collision wording minus the mean of the two rewordings, under a_legacy
wording effect under a_legacy minus wording effect under b_renamed
